about_the_game:
Step into the role of Eleanor Hartfield, a grieving widow suffering from dissociative amnesia. Wander the halls of an eerie 1920s mansion as haunting visions torment you and the line between reality and nightmare begins to blur. Unravel buried memories and uncover the chilling truth surrounding your husband’s mysterious death. 

  • Immerse yourself in an atmospheric 1920s mansion filled with secrets, shadows, and lingering dread.

  • Uncover the tragic story of Eleanor Hartfield and the mysterious death of her husband through environmental storytelling.

  • Solve cryptic puzzles and unlock hidden passages to reveal the mansion’s darkest truths.

  • Experience a slow psychological unraveling where reality and nightmare begin to blur.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains occasional gore, and mature themes, including references to suicide. It may not be suitable for all audiences.
